title: LLAVAGUARD: An Open VLM-based Framework for Safeguarding Vision Datasets and Models
findings: The paper's safety taxonomy includes the detection of hate speech based on religion as a violation. However, the paper does not present specific results or analysis for this sub-category, focusing instead on the overall performance across all safety categories.
